description.zh: Phil 博客的美学拆解：从新粗野主义、包豪斯到瑞士国际主义，拆解设计风格与视觉语言，并附上可直接复用的图像提示词。
description.en: Aesthetics on Phil's blog: design styles from Neo-Brutalism and Bauhaus to the Swiss International Style, broken down into visual language and reusable image prompts.

description.zh: Phil 博客的 AI 工具教程：ComfyUI、MiniMax、Claude Code、Obsidian 等工具的上手步骤与工作流搭建，以及真实使用中的经验和坑。
description.en: AI tutorials on Phil's blog: getting started with ComfyUI, MiniMax, Claude Code, Obsidian and more, building workflows around them, and lessons from real use.

description.zh: Phil 博客的个人思考：关于表达、职业转型、增长，以及在 AI 时代如何做事的判断与记录。
description.en: Personal notes on Phil's blog: on expression, changing careers, growth, and how to work well in the age of AI.
